id.description: == the graduated investigation item's id. THE `(Z-)?` FABRIC COORDINATE WAS MISSING UNTIL 2026-09-02 AND ITS ABSENCE MADE SITE-Z GRADUATION IMPOSSIBLE: the investigation schema accepted `{PROJECT}-Z-S{n}` while THIS pattern refused it, so a site-Z item could be filed and could never become a remediation row. The only ways past were to drop the `Z-` -- re-introducing exactly the collision the investigation schema exists to prevent (7 colliding ids over 14 distinct findings, measured 2026-08-21) -- or to file nothing. Found by 1.0.0_SA_CTO by exercising BOTH patterns against the same id rather than reading them (ETFS_GUARDRAIL-Z-S1: investigation ACCEPT, remediation REFUSE), while designing the loop remediations Andrew gated site-Z activation on. It had never fired because SCOPE_CHANGE has never fired: exactly ONE remediation file existed estate-wide.

project.description: L3 IDENTITY, half 1. The register project code this row belongs to. MUST equal the id's prefix -- the gate checks the two against each other rather than deriving one from the other, because two carriers of one quantity that are never compared are how drift starts. OPTIONAL HERE AND GATE-REQUIRED ON NEW ROWS ONLY, the same bound `spec_asserts` carries: ~190 rows predate this field and are not back-filled (Andrew-direct 2026-09-01, 'maintain now and prospectively'). WHY A FIELD AND NOT JUST THE ID PREFIX: a consumer that must regex an id to learn which project a row belongs to cannot REJECT a malformed one -- it silently mis-groups it, and the L8 monitor's whole job is grouping.

fabric.description: L3 IDENTITY, half 2, and the same enum as the project register's `fabric` key (to-pipeline-gate.py:72 FABRIC_ENUM). MUST agree with the id: `site-z` iff the id carries the `Z-` infix. Gate-checked against the id, OPTIONAL here, gate-required on NEW rows only. Before this field the fabric was encoded ONLY as the presence-or-absence of an infix -- a claim carried by a gap in a string, which no consumer can reject on.

owner.description: the lane that builds the remediation

closed.description: DISARMED IS NOT REMEDIATED: for LATENT_HAZARD, true requires disarm.state=DISARMED AND remediation.state=REMEDIATED; for other classes, remediation.state=REMEDIATED

hazard_standing.description: Whether the item, left alone, harms through future NORMAL operation. ARMED rows carry the two-state disarm block; 'latent hazard' is the prose name for (any class, ARMED).

route.description: STEP-10 ROUTING, the DECISION. One axis: WHAT DOES THE REMEDY NEED THAT DOES NOT EXIST YET? SPEC_ERROR = a cell the decomp ALREADY CONTAINS. DECOMP_INVALIDATING = a CELL the decomp does not contain (this round's completion claim is over-scoped). SCOPE_CHANGE = an OUTCOME the PRD does not name. NOTE the deliberate token reuse: DECOMP_INVALIDATING is also a `disposition` value on the investigation item -- SAME CONCEPT, two grains, and naming them differently would be the defect.

loop_target.description: STEP-10 ROUTING, the DESTINATION step. THIS IS DERIVED FROM `route`, NOT AN INDEPENDENT CHOICE -- fork 5: 'the loop-back target is not a separate decision, it IS fork 4's output'. LOCKED MAPPING, enforced by the gate: SPEC_ERROR->6 (COO re-cuts TOs), DECOMP_INVALIDATING->5 (COO re-decomposes), SCOPE_CHANGE->2 (CTO re-aligns the endpoint, then the PRD at 4). Stored rather than computed ONLY so a reader of the row alone can act on it; the gate REFUSES any pair that contradicts the mapping, so the two fields cannot drift into two carriers of one quantity.

outcome_ref.description: STEP-10 SCOPE-CHANGE PAYLOAD: the PRD outcome id this row contradicts. REQUIRED BY THE GATE WHEN route=SCOPE_CHANGE, optional otherwise. Ids are emitted by /endpoint --forward Phase 0 and are PERMANENT AND NEVER REUSED by contract (1.0.0_SA_CTO @b3584ea86a, in the skill AND the PRD template): a new outcome takes the next unused number, a retired one LEAVES ITS NUMBER VACANT, and renumbering to close a gap is FORBIDDEN. That contract is the whole reason this field can be cited at all -- renumbering silently re-points every citation ever made, and A DRIFTING ID TURNS A GROUNDED FINDING INTO A WRONG ONE WHILE IT STILL LOOKS GROUNDED. Without the permanence contract this field would have been a liability, not a feature, which is why it was withheld until 2026-09-01.

allOf.comment: ARMED rows carry the two-state block -- two states, two owners, two clocks
DISARMED IS NOT REMEDIATED: an ARMED row closes only when BOTH have landed
INERT rows close on REMEDIATED alone
